Very relaxing visit
Sep 2019 • Couples
Visited this bar twice so far in our time in Nha Trang. The owner, Paul, is a top guy who goes out of his way to make you feel welcome and does his very best to make sure you can watch your favourite sport. Of course there are always times when you won’t get the commentary of your choice if the majority want to tune into something else, but you will still get the vision. Prices are great and the bar staff are wonderful. Will definitely be back for more NRL/AFL finals action over the next couple of weekends.
